{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f'Number of unique patient_id: {df["patient_id"].nunique()}')
print(f'Total rows: {len(df)}')
print(f'Duplicates: {len(df) - df["patient_id"].nunique()}')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print(f'Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999).sum()}')

# Check assay_batch values
print(f'Unique assay_batch values: {df["assay_batch"].unique()}')

# Check if sample_seq is used correctly for deduplication
print(f'Max sample_seq per patient: {df.groupby("patient_id")["sample_seq"].max().describe()}')"}
